# Confusable `ufw show added` output: ports that share a smaller port as a
# numeric prefix (4430, 4434) but the smaller port is absent. The detect
# needle for the smaller port must NOT satisfy these — the whole-word (`-w`)
# grep stops a prefix port from matching. No comment text here repeats any
# rule needle, so only the data lines below can match.
Added user rules (see 'ufw status' for running firewall):
ufw allow 4430/tcp
ufw allow 4434/tcp
